title: Ger Reb Mendel Binke z”l
body: Gerer gabbai Reb Mendel Binke z”l, 94, passed away in Yerushalayim after a life serving the Rebbes of Ger and the Gerer kehillah.

title: Bus Segregation Ruling Issued
body: Tel Aviv court fines and awards compensation over gender segregation on Dan Bus Line 292, following January 2023 incident.
